questions: Are you currently experiencing severe difficulty breathing, severe chest pain, fainting, or a life-threatening emergency?
Have you suddenly developed weakness or numbness on one side, facial drooping, trouble speaking, confusion, or loss of vision?
Are you having severe or rapidly worsening pain anywhere?
Have you had significant bleeding, vomited blood, or passed black or bloody stool?
Have you had thoughts of harming yourself or someone else?
Do you have a fever or chills?
Have you had a new cough, wheezing, or shortness of breath?
Have you had chest discomfort, palpitations, or swelling of your legs?
Have you had headache, dizziness, fainting, seizures, or a recent head injury?
Have you had abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, or constipation?
Have you had pain or burning with urination, blood in your urine, or a change in how often you urinate?
Have you noticed a new rash, swelling, lump, or skin color change?
Have you had unexplained weight loss, marked fatigue, or night sweats?
Have you had joint pain, muscle pain, or difficulty walking or using an arm?
Have you noticed changes in your vision, hearing, memory, or balance?
Are you pregnant, or could you be pregnant?
Have you recently started, stopped, or changed any medication, supplement, or recreational drug?
Have you recently had an injury, surgery, infection, or significant travel?
Do you have any diagnosed medical conditions?
Do you have any medication or food allergies?
